t: The Soviet Union launched the first artificial satellite on 4 October 1957, starting the space age.
Yuri Gagarin became the first human in space on 12 April 1961 and orbited Earth once.
Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed on the Moon on 20 July 1969.
India’s first satellite, built by ISRO and launched on a Soviet rocket.
Two NASA probes that toured the outer planets. Voyager 1 entered interstellar space in 2012 and is the most distant human-made object.
Rakesh Sharma became the first Indian in space, flying on the Soviet Soyuz T-11 in April 1984.
Launched in 1990, it has taken some of the most detailed images of distant galaxies and nebulae.
India’s first Moon mission, launched in October 2008. Its instruments helped confirm water molecules on the lunar surface.
NASA’s rover landed in Gale Crater on Mars in August 2012 and found that the area once had conditions suited to life.
Launched on 5 November 2013 and reached Mars orbit in September 2014. India became the first country to reach Mars orbit on its first attempt.
NASA’s probe flew past Pluto on 14 July 2015 and sent the first close-up images of the dwarf planet.
India’s first dedicated space observatory, launched in September 2015 to study stars, galaxies and black holes in several kinds of light.
The orbiter works well, but the Vikram lander lost contact during its final descent in September 2019.
Launched on 25 December 2021. It looks at the universe in infrared and studies the earliest galaxies and the atmospheres of exoplanets.
Launched on 14 July 2023. On 23 August 2023 the Vikram lander touched down near the Moon’s south pole, making India the fourth country to land softly on the Moon.
India’s first solar observatory, launched on 2 September 2023. It orbits the Sun–Earth L1 point, about 1.5 million km from Earth.
Two ISRO satellites docked in orbit in January 2025, making India the fourth country to achieve space docking.
Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla flew to the International Space Station on the Axiom-4 mission in 2025.
India’s planned first crewed spaceflight. ISRO’s chief has pointed to 2027 for the crewed launch, after uncrewed test flights. Dates have moved before and may move again.
